setStreamSources(CAPTURE, EXTERNAL microphone 48 kHz mono) — before initExchange, as py-tgcalls does
initExchange(outgoing: no ga_hash) returns a 32-byte g_a_hash
sendExternalFrame accepts a 20 ms 48 kHz s16le frame once an external source exists

steps.finding: Connection with chat id "99999" not found

steps.name: static getProtocol() — the descriptor advertised in phone.requestCall

findings: F-1: index.d.ts declares Buffer for byte arguments; the native layer accepts plain number[] and rejects Buffer/Uint8Array.
F-2: index.d.ts lists enums as sequential ordinals, but runtime enums are bit flags (MediaSource.EXTERNAL=32, ConnectionState.CONNECTED=2). Always use the runtime enum objects.
F-3: for an OUTGOING call initExchange must receive no ga_hash (undefined/null/omitted -> returns the 32-byte g_a_hash); an empty array is treated as the INCOMING case (returns 256-byte g_b).
